decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The advertisement hereby permitted shall be commenced not later than the expiration of one year from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant planning permission.

Condition : 4 - No advertisment shall be sited or displayed so as to obscure, or hinder, the ready interpretation of any road sign, railway sign or aid to navigation by water or air so as to otherwise render hazardous the use of any highway, railway, waterway ( including any coastal waters) or aerodrome (civil or military).

Condition : 5 - The application for the of 15 non-illuminated signs to first floor windows and non illuminated sign to entrance door of 334 Chiswick High Road are considered acceptable having due regard for traffic and pedestrian safety, the residential amenity of nearby properties and the character and appearance of the existing building along with the site characteristics of the surrounding area. The development would comply with policies ENV B.1.4 (Advertisements) and ENV-B.1.1 (all new Developments) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and is compliant with Council's Outdoor shop front design guidelines.
description: Installation of 15 non-illuminated signs to first floor windows and non illuminated sign to entrance door
